one_line: A Deccan inland caravan trader linking Chandravalli and Banavasi’s routes in the centuries before and into the early Kadamba era.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but sturdy build from travel and manual loading.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a small healed scar on the left eyebrow, default expression alert and thoughtful with a hint of cautious optimism.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied into a short, tidy topknot at the back of the crown, sides combed back; a simple narrow off-white cotton headband wraps around the forehead under the knot to keep sweat from the eyes.
appearance.costume: A knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic crossing left over right and tied with internal ties, sleeves to mid-forearm; over it, a light mustard-yellow cotton uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back; lower garment is a deep-indigo cotton dhoti wrapped tightly and pleated to mid-calf, with a thin reddish-brown border; he wears simple brown leather sandals with thong straps; at the waist a plain dark-brown leather belt holds two small cloth pouches and a bronze-ringed cord; minimal jewellery: a single small bronze hoop earring in the left ear and a simple black-bead and bronze-amulet necklace; a modest cloth satchel in faded terracotta red hangs diagonally across his torso for documents and small goods.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized cylindrical cloth-and-leather trade pouch, slung from his right shoulder and resting at his left hip, half-open to reveal neatly wrapped silver-like coins, a single worn Roman denarius, and a palm-leaf strip with early Kannada script, symbolising Chandravalli–Banavasi trade continuity.

ref_desc: A lean late-20s Deccan trader with medium-brown skin, short black topknot and off-white headband, wearing an off-white angarkha, mustard-yellow shawl, deep-indigo dhoti with reddish-brown border, brown sandals, minimal bronze jewellery, and carrying a brown leather-slung cylindrical coin pouch showing mixed coins and a palm-leaf strip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a lean late-20s Deccan caravan trader from 1st–6th century Chandravalli–Banavasi: medium-brown complexion, oval face, sharp nose, short black hair tied in a tidy topknot, off-white cotton headband around his forehead, a small healed scar on his left eyebrow, short beard and moustache, and an alert, thoughtful expression. He wears a modest knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with mid-forearm sleeves, a light mustard-yellow cotton shawl draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around the back, and a tightly wrapped deep-indigo cotton dhoti with a thin reddish-brown border reaching mid-calf. Show simple brown leather sandals with thong straps, a plain dark-brown leather belt holding two small cloth pouches and a bronze-ringed cord, a single small bronze hoop earring in his left ear, and a black-bead necklace with a tiny bronze amulet. Across his torso hangs a faded terracotta-red cloth satchel, and his main prop is a medium-sized cylindrical cloth-and-leather coin pouch slung from his right shoulder to his left hip, half-open to reveal neatly wrapped silver-like coins, a single worn Roman-style denarius and a palm-leaf strip with early Kannada-like markings; keep the palette to off-white, mustard yellow, deep indigo, reddish brown and brown leather tones, and present him front-facing in a neutral standing pose suitable for consistent redrawing.
